# Attribute-Scaled Added Elemental Damage ("Adds A-B Damage per N Strength/Dexterity")

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Mechanic tags:** breakpoint, step-function, damage-pool

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped in the engine; not yet verified in-game. Covers Ralph's Burial ("Adds 1-6 Lightning Damage per 10 Dexterity") and Magnus' Jealousy ("Adds 2-5 Fire Damage per 10 Strength") - both armor pieces whose raw affix text carries NO scope qualifier. Owner-confirmed 2026-09-02: applies to BOTH Attacks and Spells, never Minions. floor(attribute_total/N) x per-1-point min/max, added to both {type}_attack_dmg_flat_{min,max} and {type}_spell_dmg_flat_{min,max}. End-to-end folded-value math spot-checked manually (55 Strength, unit 10, per-unit .25/.45 -> 12.5/22.5 on both attack and spell pools) but not confirmed against a live client.
